name: scope

findings.message: The manifest description still names `claimed:<machine>` and the TOCTOU backoff-and-reverify behaviour that was removed from plugin.sh, leaving the manifest inconsistent with the plugin it describes.
findings.quote:
Uses GitHub issue labels
  (`claimed:<machine>`) as the cross-machine claim mechanism, ported from
  legacy-DoNotUse/scripts/lib/daemon-state.sh:602-720.

  Has a documented TOCTOU window between add-label and re-verify. Mitigated
  by random backoff (300–1100 ms) and a re-read step that drops the claim
  if multiple `claimed:*` labels are observed.
findings.trigger: Anyone reading manifest.yaml to understand the plugin sees a description that names a label format (`claimed:<machine>`) that no longer exists and a backoff mechanism (the `sleep` and re-verify phase) that was deleted from plugin.sh in this change.
findings.accepted_if: The manifest description reflects the single shared `zbuild:claimed` label and no longer references `claimed:<machine>` or the removed TOCTOU backoff-and-reverify behaviour.

reason: the scope lens found no medium or high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
